items.title: Uber now lets you book rides that record the drive by default
items.summary: Uber is piloting a new feature in the U.S. that offers rides in which drivers have enabled the company’s recording feature, Record My Ride. The option, which uses the front camera of the Uber driver’s phone to record the entire drive, will show up as “Recorded Rides” in the app. The ride-hailing company is starting […]
